craft_notes: Sthāyin: shine-joy. Close: made (consciousness-made). Rejected: 'all-pervading one' title — killed: pervader kept; 'shines forth' flat — shines kept.

lines: Whose form is knowing and knowable, by supreme power yoked;
in two states the pervader shines — elsewhere, consciousness-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānajñeyasvarūpiṇyā śaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | padadvaye vibhur bhāti tadanyatra tu cinmayaḥ
